title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
summary: A playful grasshopper refuses to work while a busy ant saves food for winter.
coverScene: A bright green grasshopper sings on a sunny leaf while a busy ant carries food across the garden ground.

sentences.text: All summer long, a small animal sings and plays in the warm air.

Every piece of grain that is collected represents a step toward safety.
The family helps him organize the store room with great care.
